## Specific task description

Task instruction: Click the top button of the alarm-clock for bedside table

Task description: The target is the black alarm clock on the right side of the table, behind the instant noodle bowl. Use the right gripper to press its top button.

Success criteria: The closed right gripper physically touches the surface near the alarm clock's top button, with contact horizontally close to the button and at approximately its height. Merely hovering above it without contact is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Use both the overhead and side views to locate the button and determine the gripper tip height. Bring the closed gripper tip down toward it in small steps, avoiding mistaking image overlap for actual contact.
- There is an instant-noodle bowl in front of the clock. Adjust the gripper pose where there is clearance above the clock body to reduce contact with the bowl rim or clock case during low lateral movement.
